arguments.sql:
SELECT 'diagnosis' AS field, p.Diagnosis AS value, COUNT(*) AS records
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' OR p.Diagnosis LIKE '%lupus%'
GROUP BY p.Diagnosis
UNION ALL
SELECT 'degree', e.Thrombosis, COUNT(*) FROM Examination AS e GROUP BY e.Thrombosis
UNION ALL
SELECT 'symptoms', e.Symptoms, COUNT(*)
FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis > 0 AND (p.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' OR p.Diagnosis LIKE '%lupus%')
GROUP BY e.Symptoms

arguments.sql:
SELECT e.Symptoms AS symptom
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis > 0
  AND (' ' || REPLACE(UPPER(p.Diagnosis), 'SLE SUSP', '') || ' ')
      GLOB '*[^A-Z0-9]SLE[^A-Z0-9]*'
  AND TRIM(e.Symptoms) <> ''
GROUP BY e.Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, e.Symptoms ASC
LIMIT 1
